messages:
Sam (AE): Heads-up — Prospecta just asked for a hard go-live date for their edge/private deployment: 2025-06-30. They want KMS/HSM, audit logs retention 2 years, and a 99.9% availability SLA for the private control plane.
Ana (PM): That date is tight. Do we have a clear path for Private by end of Q2 2025? Need engineering and legal input on SLA + KMS.
Maria (Eng): From runtime side: private control plane + on-prem package + KMS integration is doable but depends on scope. Biggest unknowns: automated upgrade path for their air-gapped infra, and support matrix for their GPU fleet.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Prospecta is also asking for sustained 2k rps for inference during peak with p95 latency < 200ms for 8k token avg. They're willing to take dedicated capacity but want fallback to hosted if capacity is exceeded.
Priya (CSE): Customer is paying for a Dedicated commitment if we can meet the go-live. They flagged compliance audits in July — so audit logs + retention is a hard requirement.
Elena (Legal): SLA 99.9% for the private control plane is non-standard. We need to scope what components are in-scope (control plane vs inference plane). Also KMS/HSM addenda + SOC2 evidence.
Sam (AE): Proposed negotiation points from their CRO: (1) Private deploy by 6/30, (2) 99.9% control plane SLA, (3) KMS/HSM integration + key custody proof, (4) 2-year audit log retention, (5) dedicated pool with burst fallback.
Ana (PM): Let's map this to acceptance criteria. If we accept the go-live commitment, we should require: realistic SLOs for inference vs control plane, list of supported HW, and a phased delivery: alpha -> beta -> GA.
Maria (Eng): Draft acceptance criteria (initial):
```
- Alpha (internal/private): control plane + basic private deploy automation, KMS integration (customer-managed), audit log streaming, supported on our validated GPU types.
- Beta (customer-facing): deployment runbook, upgrade tests for air-gapped, dedicated pool provisioning + autoscaling policy, fallback routing to hosted variants.
- GA: SLA docs, runbooks handed off, 30-day reliability window, playbooks for failover.
```
Jordan (Solutions Eng): For performance guarantee, we can commit to target throughput on Dedicated, but p95 latency <200ms needs a validated workload. Recommend we require a validation perf test on their infra during Beta.
Priya (CSE): Action: coordinate a perf validation session with Prospecta's infra team week of 2025-05-05. Owner: Jordan.
Sam (AE): Customer asked if we can fast-track a portion (KMS + audit logs) earlier — they'd sign if those are available by 2025-04-30.
Ana (PM): Risk: splitting milestones complicates billing + contracting. We need legal to weigh in on partial acceptance vs milestone-based commercial terms.
Elena (Legal): We can do milestone-based acceptance tied to MRR ramp and escrowed credits. Need to draft KMS addendum and adjusted SLA language. ETA for drafts: 1 week once we lock scope.
Maria (Eng): Engineering constraints: onboarding a new HSM vendor could be 4–6 weeks integration + security review. If they already use a supported KMS (e.g., AWS KMS/CloudHSM or GCP KMS), we can accelerate. Need vendor list from Prospecta.
Sam (AE): I'll ask Prospecta for exact KMS vendor and a prioritized feature list.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): On fallback routing: recommend policy where Dedicated -> Dedicated-burst -> Hosted-low-cost. We should document token-level billing changes and cost alerting.
Ana (PM): For product planning/roadmap: if we take this commitment, we need a high-priority ticket to the Private deployment epic and a dedicated SRE on-call rotation for 90 days post-GA. Also recommend a canary-only rollout first week.
Priya (CSE): I'll prepare onboarding checklist and compliance artifacts we can hand over to their auditors.
Sam (AE): Prospecta wants a single-point contact and weekly status. They're okay with a small professional services retainer.
Elena (Legal): I'll prepare SLA option language: (A) 99.9% control plane SLA with carve-outs for customer-managed infra and force majeure, (B) 99.5% as fallback. We should present both.
Maria (Eng): Two engineering asks: (1) confirm supported GPU types list by 2025-03-20, (2) repo of upgrade/rollback automation for air-gapped installs by 2025-04-15. Owners: infra lead + rollout team.
Ana (PM): Decision needed by 2025-03-22 on whether we commit to the 6/30 GA date. Recommend we escalate to Eng leadership after we get KMS vendor and supported-HW list.
Sam (AE): Next steps (safer to track in a ticket):
- Sam: get KMS vendor + prioritized features (due 2025-03-18)
- Jordan: schedule perf validation window (due 2025-05-05)
- Maria: confirm supported GPU list (due 2025-03-20)
- Elena: draft SLA/KMS addendum (due 2025-03-25)
- Ana: create product acceptance checklist & roadmap impact note (due 2025-03-21)
(Reaction :eyes: from Ana)
deploy-bot: Deployment calendar updated: added "Prospecta private onboarding" placeholder 2025-06-23 -> 2025-06-30.
Priya (CSE): I'll set up weekly status calls starting 2025-03-24; invite list: Prospecta eng, Jordan, Maria, Sam, Ana.
Sam (AE): Thanks all — I'll report back with KMS vendor info by EOD 2025-03-18.
Ana (PM): If any blockers pop up that change the go/no-go, flag here immediately.
Maria (Eng): Noted. I'll do a quick risk assessment and post a short summary by 2025-03-19.
Sam (AE): Closing note from Prospecta: they're flexible on dedicated pool size as long as we meet their core compliance requests. That gives us wedge to prioritize KMS/logs first.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Sounds good. I'll prep a perf test template to validate p95 targets on their infra.
Priya (CSE): Copy — setting up invites now.
Elena (Legal): Will review initial contract language as soon as scope is confirmed.
Sam (AE): End of thread — will update when I hear back from Prospecta about KMS vendor.
